title: 2.2 Measurement and Safety
description: Measurement and Safety concepts and applications. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A rope is used to measure a plot while a 50 cm ruler and a 6 m stick are also available. Which choice gives a standard result in meters?
options: The 6 m stick used repeatedly
The rope only in the textbook
The 50 cm ruler only in class
Footsteps along the plot here

questions.question: A student measures a book in meters, centimeters and millimeters. Which statement is accurate?
options: The millimeter reading has more subdivisions
The meter reading is always largest in class
The units measure different quantities still
The centimeter unit is an SI base unit still
questions.correctAnswer: The millimeter reading has more subdivisions

questions.question: Which list contains only instruments for measuring length?
options: Ruler, tape and calipers
Balance, stopwatch and thermometer
Clock, watch and sundial
Thermometer, balance and stopwatch

questions.question: Which list contains only instruments for measuring time?
options: Stopwatch, clock and digital watch
Ruler, tape and calipers in nature
Beam balance and scale pan as well
Thermometer and barometer in class

questions.question: A farmer reports mass using the palm as a unit. What is the consequence?
options: Different people obtain different amounts
All results are reproducible for students
The unit is an SI base unit in this topic
The measurement is exact now for students

questions.question: Which statement about mass measurement is accurate?
options: Mass is the amount of matter in a body
Mass is the force of gravity on a body
Mass is measured in meters
Mass is measured with a clock
questions.correctAnswer: Mass is the amount of matter in a body

questions.question: A student must measure the thickness of a thin metal sheet. Which instrument is most suitable?
options: Micrometer screw gauge now
A 6 m stick in experiments
A beam balance in the unit
A measuring cylinder still

questions.question: Which lab action shows correct electrical safety practice?
options: Switching off before adjusting the circuit
Touching bare wires by hand in experiments
Using wet hands on plugs now in this topic
Overloading a single socket in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Switching off before adjusting the circuit

questions.question: Which rule concerns clothing in the laboratory?
options: Avoid baggy clothing and dangling jewelry
Wear open-toed sandals now in experiments
Wear bulky bracelets here in the textbook
Carry extra books to the bench in physics
questions.correctAnswer: Avoid baggy clothing and dangling jewelry

questions.question: Which activity is allowed during a lab session?
options: Performing only authorized experiments now
Tasting chemicals in class in the textbook
Working alone after hours now for students
Applying cosmetics at the bench in physics

questions.question: What is the correct way to record a measured value?
options: Write the number together with its unit
Write only the number now in this topic
Write only the unit now in the textbook
Write the instrument name in this topic
questions.correctAnswer: Write the number together with its unit

questions.question: Which quantity is described as the duration between the start and end of an event?
options: Time
Length
Mass
Area

questions.question: Which quantity is described as the distance between two points?
options: Length
Time
Mass
Temperature

questions.question: Why do digital instruments make reading easier?
options: They show the measured value directly now
They operate without any power in physics
They have no units as well in experiments
They remove the need for measurement here
questions.correctAnswer: They show the measured value directly now

questions.question: Which traditional method uses the position of an upright objects shadow?
options: Sundial
Beam balance
Micrometer
Measuring cylinder

questions.question: Which action is a safety rule about lab workspace?
options: Keep only needed books and notebooks on the bench
Bring all personal belongings now in the textbook
Keep food on the bench in physics in the textbook
Keep bags on the floor near wires in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Keep only needed books and notebooks on the bench

questions.question: What should be done with all accidents in the laboratory?
options: Report every one immediately, even minor ones
Report only major ones as well in experiments
Record them at the end of term in experiments
Ignore minor ones for students in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Report every one immediately, even minor ones

questions.question: Which statement about SI and non-SI units is accurate?
options: SI units can be converted to non-SI units now
Non-SI units cannot be converted for students
SI units are used only in Ethiopia in physics
Non-SI units have no names now in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: SI units can be converted to non-SI units now

questions.question: Which instrument would measure the mass of a duster in a school activity?
options: Beam balance as well
Meter rule in nature
Stopwatch in physics
Thermometer in class

questions.question: Which activity must happen before entering a laboratory?
options: Reading about the experiment
Eating a snack in this topic
Touching the equipment still
Choosing a partner in nature
